hints.title: Apply Bezout Identity
hints.text: A subset of integers has integer linear combinations equal to 1 if and only if their greatest common divisor is 1.

hints.title: Include Additional Elements Monotonically
hints.text: Adding more numbers to a set can only decrease or maintain the overall greatest common divisor.

hints.title: Compute Cumulative GCD
hints.text: Calculate the cumulative greatest common divisor across the entire array; return true if it ever reaches 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating subset combinations and linear equations is NP-hard or exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Number theory reduction shows array is good if and only if overall GCD is 1 in O(N log(MAX)) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize Bezout identity and terminate early if GCD hits 1.
complexity.notes: Euclidean GCD algorithm runs in logarithmic time per step.
